description: Dispositifs de séparation du trafic is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.data.shom.fr. "Traffic Separation Schemes" product contains a description of TSS in French maritime spaces. A TSS is a routeing measure aimed at the separation of opposing streams of traffic by appropriate means and notably by the establishment of traffic lanes. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic separation schemes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include PRCARE, TSSBND, RDOCAL, TSEZNE, TSSLPT, ISTZNE. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2021-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
